extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for the executors of an illiquid Reading estate valued at about £207,000 enquires about borrowing £29,500 to cover inheritance tax and legal fees while awaiting the grant of probate.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry regarding the Reading estate on behalf of the executors. We have noted the estimated estate value of £207,000 and the £29,500 sought for inheritance tax and professional fees pending the grant. To take this further we would need the names and contact details of the executors, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities, confirmation of any IHT payment deadline, details of the will and whether any disputes or claims are anticipated, and confirmation of your firm's involvement in the administration. Once we have those details a member of our team will review the enquiry and come back to you.
